_README: Watchtower for your own Pudge deployments. Run: node ckb-monitor.mjs --net testnet --watch watchlist.testnet.json --serve [--webhook https://hooks...]. Each watch alerts on a matching tx (hit); with idleMin it also fires a SILENT alarm when nothing has matched for that many minutes, and BACK when it resumes. Identifiers pulled from cells-protocol/docs/TESTNET.md, liquid-cells/DEPLOY.md, and cardano-ckb-bridge.

watches.name: liquid-cells-sequencer
watches.desc: checkpoint advances (anchor type-id); silence past 30m = a stall

watches.name: bridge-deployer
watches.desc: deployer / governor lock receives funds or change (bridge activity)
